description: Angular component for managing map data layers, including form handling, drag-and-drop reordering, and validation within a widget configuration.

classes.name: MapDataLayersComponent
classes.description: Angular component for configuring and managing map data layers with form controls, drag-and-drop, and validation.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, sets up form group, and subscribes to form value changes.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback function to propagate changes.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Placeholder for registering touch callback (not implemented).

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls based on input.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Sets the form control value based on external data.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the form group and returns validation status.

methods.name: dataLayersFormArray
methods.description: Returns the form array of data layers.

methods.name: trackByDataLayer
methods.description: Track function for data layer controls in the template.

methods.name: removeDataLayer
methods.description: Removes a data layer at specified index.

methods.name: layerDrop
methods.description: Handles drag-and-drop reordering of data layers.

methods.name: addDataLayer
methods.description: Adds a new data layer with default settings.

methods.name: prepareDataLayersFormArray
methods.description: Prepares form array controls from data layer settings array.
